relations.product: human iPS cell-derived cardiomyocytes, manufactured by DNP under a licensing agreement with NEXEL (TriNebula Cell Tech joint venture)
relations.quote: Under a licensing agreement with NEXEL, DNP will manufacture cardiomyocytes and aims to establish a global manufacturing and sales structure based on market and customer needs identified through TriNebula’s marketing activities.
relations.label: Dai Nippon Printing press release: DNP, NEXEL and CMIC Pharma Science Establish Joint Venture (10-09-2026)
